end = t.index('    emitter.label("__rt_tmpfile_fail_x86");')
named = t[start:end]
rest = t[end:]
brace = rest.rindex('}')
# The x86 failure path plus the closing brace; the named helper goes between them.
p.write_text(t[:start] + rest[:brace] + named + rest[brace:])
print('the x86 anonymous helper keeps its own failure path too')
